## Fasta til `DataFrame`

The widget below accepts "fasta" files as input and you can then use the slider to adjust the pH and see how the charge of your protein changes. 

Fasta-files is a specific type of text file and you will see that most of the time when you download a Protein, RNA or DNA sequence they will be downloaded as fasta files. Each sequence begins with a header line starting with >, which contains an identifier and optionally a description, followed by the sequence itself using the appropriate nucleotide or amino acid symbols. A FASTA file can contain one or multiple sequences, making it useful for sequence analysis, database searches, and comparing biological sequences using bioinformatics tools.


```{python}
#| eval: false
from fysisk_biokemi.widgets.sequence_properties import sequence_dataframe

widget = sequence_dataframe()
```

You can extract the dataframe with your current pH adjustment by using the widget.get_dataframe() below. 

```{python}
#| eval: false
df = widget.get_dataframe()
```
